purpose: NEW isolated always-on workflow that ticks the Windows LOCAL_DEV autonomous dispatcher every 5 minutes over Tailscale-private transport, normalizes the bounded tick result, and notifies Telegram ONLY for human-gate / executor-STOP / service-error outcomes. No WF40 node graph change. No production authorization. No D-0025 activation. Notification-only Telegram usage; credentials are cloned in memory at LIVE APPLY time and never persisted in this artifact.
authority_note: This workflow JSON is GPT-Web-authored per operator dispatch V4_LOCAL_DEV_N8N_ALWAYS_ON_LIVE_FAST_TRACK_V1 (GPT_WEB authoring override of GPT_WEB_N8N_AUTHORING_REQUIRED).

target_workflow.name_exact: 90 - CP V4 LOCAL DEV ALWAYS-ON DISPATCHER - ACTIVE

parameters.jsCode:
const requestId = 'n8n-local-dev-' + new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:.TZ]/g, '').slice(0, 14) + '-' + $execution.id + '-' + $itemIndex;
return { json: { schema_version: 'local-dev-dispatch-tick-v1', request_id: requestId, source: 'n8n' } };

nodes.name: HTTP Request - LOCAL_DEV dispatcher tick
nodes.notes: Tailscale tailnet-private transport only. No Funnel. No authorization object. No credential.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $credentials.telegramChatId, text: ['LOCAL_DEV AUTO DISPATCH', 'classification: ' + $json.classification, 'task: ' + ($json.task_ref || 'NONE'), 'gate: ' + ($json.gate_summary || ($json.reason_codes || []).join(',') || 'none'), 'origin: n8n always-on dispatcher'].join('\n') }) }}

nodes.name: Telegram - LOCAL_DEV gate notification
nodes.notes: LIVE APPLY ONLY: clone Telegram credential metadata IN MEMORY from live WF40 node 'Telegram - Send PM21 bridge summary' (secret-safe; never persist credential id/chat id in repo artifacts). Notification only; no buttons; no decision semantics.
